children: Slam Corp., a blank‑check acquisition vehicle, reported a net loss of $2.9M for the quarter ended June 30, 2025, and basic and diluted net loss per share of $(0.18) for both Class A and Class B shares, reflecting higher public‑company costs since its IPO and no operating revenues to date.
Net income: Net loss of $2.9M for 2Q 2025 (three months ended June 30, 2025) vs. net loss of $1.6M in the year‑ago quarter.
Diluted EPS: Basic and diluted net loss per share $0.18 for Class A and $0.18 for Class B for the three months ended June 30, 2025 (versus $(0.07) per share in the year‑ago quarter).
Operational focus: Slam Corp. remains a blank‑check acquisition vehicle preparing for an initial business combination and has not operated commercially.
Revenue/activity: No operating revenues to date; only non‑operating interest income is expected post‑IPO until a business combination closes.
Cost structure: Public‑company compliance and due‑diligence costs increased after the IPO, driving higher G&A expenses.
Liquidity & execution risk: Management is relying on sponsor funding and loans to support transaction costs and pursue a target.
Forward outlook: The company intends to use IPO proceeds, private placements and other financing to complete an initial business combination.
